---
title: "Learning Resources"
---

For a more in-depth list of functions (sorted alphabetically), we suggest looking at documentation from [Boston University](https://www.bu.edu/math/files/2013/08/LongTeX1.pdf). For a list sorted more thematically, we suggest looking at the [LaTeX2e unofficial reference manual](https://latexref.xyz/).

There are also tutorials such as those from Overleaf, found [here](https://www.overleaf.com/learn) that you can actively follow along and learn with.
